name: tutor-system
description: 基于大语言模型 Agent 的专升本个性化自适应学习系统

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tutor/server && npm run build -w @tutor/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @tutor/server" "npm run dev -w @tutor/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @tutor/server && npm run typecheck -w @tutor/web
scripts.db:setup: npm run migrate && npm run migrate:wrongbook
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build
